paragraphs.source_en: (I) The day before yesterday she danced in a great hall lit like a crystal palace-- How bright her stockings were! How sleek her hair was! The laughing trace of her teeth drove all the men in the hall mad with enchantment. (II) Yesterday she ran short of capital, and sold off her soul; The devil in the trumpet hat whispered secrets into her ear, and her wrinkled face was painted again with no small measure of men's heart-blood. (III) Today, this ugly old woman sitting on the step before the City God Temple has a string hanging at her breast: not pearls, but the skulls of men; The gods shake their heads when they see her, and devils tremble at the sight of her!

units.source_en: (I) The day before yesterday she danced in a great hall lit like a crystal palace-- How bright her stockings were!
units.source_zh:
（一）

前天她在水晶宮似照亮的大廳裏跳舞──

多麼亮她的襪！

units.source_en: The laughing trace of her teeth drove all the men in the hall mad with enchantment.
units.source_zh: 她那牙齒笑痕叫全堂的男子們瘋魔。

units.source_en: (II) Yesterday she ran short of capital, and sold off her soul;
units.source_zh:
（二）

昨天她短了資本，

變賣了她的靈魂；

units.source_en: The devil in the trumpet hat whispered secrets into her ear, and her wrinkled face was painted again with no small measure of men's heart-blood.
units.source_zh:
那戴喇叭帽的魔鬼在她的耳邊傳授了秘訣，

她起了皺紋的臉又搽上不少男子們的心血。

units.source_en: (III) Today, this ugly old woman sitting on the step before the City God Temple has a string hanging at her breast: not pearls, but the skulls of men;

（三）

今天在城隍廟前階沿上坐著的這個老醜，

她胸前掛著一串，不是珍珠，是男子們的骷髏；

units.source_en: The gods shake their heads when they see her, and devils tremble at the sight of her!
units.source_zh:
神道見了她搖頭，

魔鬼見了她哆嗦！

paragraphs.source_zh:
（一）

前天她在水晶宮似照亮的大廳裏跳舞──

多麼亮她的襪！

多麼滑她的髮！

她那牙齒笑痕叫全堂的男子們瘋魔。

（二）

昨天她短了資本，

變賣了她的靈魂；

那戴喇叭帽的魔鬼在她的耳邊傳授了秘訣，

她起了皺紋的臉又搽上不少男子們的心血。

（三）

今天在城隍廟前階沿上坐著的這個老醜，

她胸前掛著一串，不是珍珠，是男子們的骷髏；

神道見了她搖頭，

魔鬼見了她哆嗦！
